invariants.rationale: Method calls such as contains, lastIndexOf, and substring on name require it to be non-null.
It is likely that region names are non-empty; passing an empty name to parseRegionName is probably unintended.
name.contains("atlas_imagelayer") is equivalent to name.indexOf("atlas_imagelayer") >= 0, both usages are common for substring search.
A valid lastIndexOf('/') is always less than name.length(); prevents out of bounds errors.
Alternative to name.length() > 0, asserts that the input string is not empty which likely matches expectations based on method intent.
